meta.title: KBRTP
meta.description: KyberTop. A personal site, resource directory, and gaming tools.

footer.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with the game studios linked from here.

home.title: KBRTP
home.lede: A quiet personal site for projects, references, and the games I actually play.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lede: Things that already exist. The previous site stays available, unchanged, under /1.

solar.title: Solar Voyage
solar.body: A scrollable 3D path from the Sun to Neptune, with the Moon, nearby worlds, and the Local Group.

site.title: KBRTP hub
site.body: This site. Portfolio, resources, weather, and gaming tools on the same domain.

resources.title: Resources
resources.lede: Sources this site actually uses. Search them, or narrow by topic.

items.meteo: Weather and geocoding. Forecasts are shown with Open-Meteo attribution.
items.fortnite: Item shop, cosmetics, and shop history used for rare-return dates.
items.nightlight: Current Shrine of Secrets, including the published machine-readable feed.
items.tricky: Versioned Dead by Daylight perk and character dataset for the local build tool.
items.epic: Official free-games page. Promotions on this site come from Epic's public catalog feed.
items.outlast: The Outlast Trials stats tracker. Public statistics need an account link on their side.
items.giscus: Guestbook comments stored as GitHub Discussions.
items.archive: The previous kbrtp.top solar system site.

guestbook.title: Guestbook
guestbook.lede: Messages are stored in GitHub Discussions through Giscus. A GitHub account is required to post. This is not anonymous.
guestbook.setupTitle: Guestbook is wired, and Discussions are not enabled yet.
guestbook.setupBody: The page will show the real thread after the repository owner finishes these steps. No stand-in comments are shown.
guestbook.stepInstall: Install the Giscus GitHub App on that repository.
guestbook.stepCategory: Create a Guestbook category and paste its category ID into src/config/giscus.ts.
guestbook.missing: Until then, visitors can still read this note. Posting starts only after GitHub authentication works.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Stored in this browser only. Nothing here creates an account.
settings.rareHelp: A cosmetic qualifies only after this many complete days away from the shop.

common.fallback: English names were used because the requested language was unavailable.

weather.title: Weather
weather.remember: Remember this city on this device
weather.denied: Location permission was denied. Search for a city instead.
weather.privacy: Location is requested only after you press the button, and it is sent only to Open-Meteo.

steam.title: Steam
steam.noGame: No current game was in the public profile.
steam.recentMissing: Recently played games are not in the public profile XML.
steam.snapshot: Public profile snapshot. This is not a live presence indicator.

discord.title: Discord
discord.note: A username alone cannot show presence. Status appears only if an authorized integration is added later.
discord.noProfile: No Discord profile URL is configured.

epic.title: Free games
epic.noneCurrent: No confirmed free-to-claim promotion in this snapshot.
epic.noneUpcoming: No upcoming free promotion was announced in this snapshot.
epic.snapshot: Snapshot from Epic's public promotions feed. A discount is not labeled free.
epic.permanent: Permanently free in the feed, not a limited claim.

fortnite.title: Fortnite
fortnite.source: Data from Fortnite-API. Images are theirs.
fortnite.noRare: No cosmetic in this shop has a verified absence that long.
fortnite.included: Included in a bundle. Individual price was not listed.

dbd.title: Dead by Daylight
dbd.emptyFavorites: No builds saved in this browser.
dbd.challengeNote: A local prompt, not an official achievement or tome.
dbd.library: Every perk in the loaded dataset.
dbd.noPerks: Not enough compatible perks for four slots.
dbd.fallback: Showing the last saved shrine because the live feed did not respond.
dbd.description: Highest listed tier from the dataset.

challenges.teachable: Teachables from one random character, filled with general perks if needed

outlast.title: The Outlast Trials
outlast.lede: A profile card for the public tracker. Statistics stay on their site.
outlast.noApi: outlasttrialsstats.com does not publish a public API for player statistics. Their Discord bot reads stats only after a player links an account.
outlast.noEmbed: The site sends framing restrictions, so this page does not embed it.
outlast.steamContext: Steam's public profile snapshot last reported this game: {{game}}.
outlast.configure: A direct profile URL can be added in src/config/profile.ts when one exists.
outlast.noStats: No trials, grades, or records are shown here, because none were provided by a public feed.

gaming.title: Gaming
gaming.lede: Compact entry points. Each game keeps the same type, spacing, and controls as the rest of KBRTP.
gaming.fortniteBody: Today's shop, long absences, and cosmetic search.
gaming.dbdBody: The current shrine and a local perk builder.
gaming.outlastBody: A link to the tracker, without invented stats.
gaming.freeBody: Epic promotions that are actually free to claim.
